source_range: The current contiguous Sovereign Standard vessel range, beginning with unit 0
construction: Study 0012 remains intact. Study 0013 removes the glass planes and every simulated shadow, leaving black room lines and tightly separated red, green, and blue cube layers. Red remains dominant: its persistent frame is full strength and carries sixty percent of the shared ten-percent facet opacity, while green and blue remain quieter fringes. The chromatic separation is resolved in drawing-buffer pixels and never exceeds one rendered pixel at any view or device scale. Facets fade to zero over the common 4.05-second return interval, then refill. The cube loops forward through states 0–63 at six times the earlier pace while automatic rotation remains at half speed.
invariants: every vessel contributes exactly its canonical 64 ordered sigil positions
depth remains the mean row of the incoming canonical swap
the Study 0011 vessel selector and private Studio save loop
the Study 0010 entered-room and open-edge rules
room lines remain visible while glass faces, shader illumination, and shadow-like planes do not render
the red canonical path, red dot, full scaffold, and unconnected points do not render
one cube traversal follows the hidden path and leaves slightly separated red, green, and blue wireframes at every visited state
box motion loops forward through all 64 states and returns directly from state 63 to state 0
each state's RGB facets share a maximum combined ten percent opacity and fade to zero over the 64-step interval until that state is revisited
the RGB wireframes at every visited state remain at constant opacity with no fade
the chromatic offset is red-dominant, camera-aware, and contained within one rendered pixel
new states arrive every 0.0633 seconds, six times the earlier cube pace, without waiting for earlier fades
the box never occupies an interpolated position between canonical states
every automatic camera-time coefficient is exactly half the Study 0012 speed
manual orbit and automatic rotation change only the camera

controls.vessel: load any sigil in the current snapshotted vessel range
controls.saved: load a sigil previously saved by the Studio steward
controls.save: persist the selected vessel, box-loop state, and rotation state as a private Studio working record
controls.box_loop: turn the six-times-speed red-box traversal and its revisit-timed fades on or off
controls.rotate: turn automatic camera rotation on or off
controls.orbit: drag freely through a full 360-degree inspection
